# 拾序的第一份公开版本 🐾

把事情放在这里，把心思留给当下。手绘橘猫、奶油书桌与午夜手记，陪你安排课程截止、学术报告和每周组会。

## 下载使用

下载下方 `Shixu-0.1.0-windows-x64.zip`，完整解压后双击 `拾序.exe`。无需 Node.js、Python 或账号。保留 exe 旁的全部文件。

支持 Windows 系统通知、每日打卡、每周重复、10 分钟后再提醒、托盘运行与可选自启动；数据保存在 `%APPDATA%\Shixu`。完整说明见 [中文 README](https://github.com/womeimingzi/shixu#readme)。

## English

A Windows desktop planner with a hand-drawn cat, warm day/night themes, deadlines, weekly events, daily check-ins, native notifications, and local backups.

Download `Shixu-0.1.0-windows-x64.zip`, extract the entire archive, then open `拾序.exe`. No developer tools or account required. See the [English README](https://github.com/womeimingzi/shixu/blob/main/README.en.md).

## 当前限制 / Current limits

- 简体中文界面 / Simplified Chinese interface.
- 日程固定使用 UTC+8 / Schedule times use UTC+8.
- 软件退出、电脑睡眠或关机时不提醒 / No notifications while the app has exited or Windows is asleep/off.
- 暂无手机推送、云同步或自动更新 / No mobile push, cloud sync, or automatic updates.
- Windows x64 免安装版，未签名 / Unsigned Windows x64 portable build.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains the release archive's checksum. Project code is available under the MIT license; dependency notices are included in the package.
